verdict.rationale: Inngest's docs document scheduled functions with cron schedules and timezone support via createFunction() (inngest-docs-17, inngest-docs-31). The docs also position the product for 'background and scheduled jobs' with steps built in (inngest-docs-24). A community user confirms they adopted it for a 'scheduling, queue, trigger solution' (inngest-comm-1). Missing for 10: detailed independent hands-on corroboration of cron reliability, and evidence of managing schedules programmatically or agent-driven (e.g. via MCP/API) for the AI-native persona.
